Figure 7-68, “L113007 Brake Actuator,” lists L113007 quantity 2 and N8695 hydraulic master cylinder, specified as 200 mm stroke, quantity 1. Its repair kit is N8937, quantity 1; the kit notes that some included check-valve and seat parts are not used in this actuator (assembly: https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/na/heavy-equipment/wheel-loaders/naer90whe018w/case-wheel-loader-north-america/brakes/l113007-brake-actuator/cn/4D9B6E81-8FBF-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6/D8E26496-EFBE-E111-9FCE-005056875BD6; products: https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/category/brakes/misc-brakes/hydraulic-cylinder/p/N8695, https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/category/brakes/misc-brakes/hydraulic-cylinder/p/L113007, https://www.mycnhstore.com/us/en/casece/category/brakes/misc-brakes/kit/p/N8937).

The correct part remains unresolved without identifying the installed brake actuator: N9055/N8469 belong to the L107985/L112959 actuator figure, while N8695 belongs to the distinct L113007 actuator figure. These candidates should not be treated as interchangeable from the catalog evidence alone.
